newsitem.title: USA: Madge plans to focus on four core areas.
newsitem.headline: Madge plans to focus on four core areas.

text.p: Madge Networks said on Thursday it expects to reduce operating expenses and return to profitablility by restructuring its focus.
The company will focus on four core consumer markets: token ring users, Ethernet users, companies deploying video conferencing and carriers deploying ISDN.

Robert Madge, chairman and chief executive officer, said, "we can significantly reduce our internal infrastructure, which was built to support a full end-to-end networking solution, thus reducing our costs and helping us return to healthy profitability."
By reducing operating costs, Madge aims to quickly return to profitability, positioning the company for growth in the long term.
The company anticipates reducing operating expenses by around one-third over the next two quarters.

Most of the savings come from a reduction in the number of business centers world-wide and from scaling back the company's investment in ATM research and development, both resulting in reduced headcount.
"Restructuring into these four divisions enables Madge to concentrate on the customer segments where we can add the most value and compete most effectively," Madge concluded.
Madge Networks NV is a Dutch company that develops and markets computer networking products.
